phase: DEV-24 Execution Validation Safety Gate Engine
commitMessage: DEV-24: Build deterministic execution validation safety gate engine
objective: Create a deterministic execution validation safety gate engine that consumes DEV-23 execution manifests, validates execution tasks against River Development Agent safety policies, detects approval requirements and scope violations, and produces explainable validation results before any future execution workflow.
architecturalContext: River Development Agent roadmap Generation II
acceptanceCriteria: Validation engine consumes DEV-23 execution manifests instead of independently analyzing repositories.
Validation results are deterministic for identical execution manifests.
Every execution task receives an explainable validation decision.
Approval-required actions are identified before execution.
Validation output contains execution readiness state.
Repository state remains unchanged during validation analysis.
Focused tests, River Dev typechecking, and main-project typechecking pass.
